title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.37545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction,

translated_title: GroundControl：基于卫星图像条件化的多视角扩散模型，实现无需重建的新视角合成
translated_abstract: 多视角或视频扩散模型近来已成为从稀疏图像集合中进行新视角合成的最先进方法。虽然它们能够生成高质量的图像，但在合成超出输入视角范围的视图（即场景外推）时，往往会幻觉出不真实的空间布局。我们提出通过使用卫星图像作为额外的信息源来对多视角生成模型进行条件化，从而解决室外场景的这一挑战。我们引入了一种新的卫星条件化多视角扩散模型，在生成新视角时结合来自卫星图像和街景级输入图像的条件信息。我们基于交叉注意力的条件化机制使我们能够保留预训练的多视角扩散先验，从少量源视角生成无缝、逼真的新视角，同时遵循卫星图像中所呈现的场景布局。我们的模型不使用3D场景重建，
tldr: 该论文提出GroundControl，一种将卫星图像作为额外条件信息的多视角扩散模型，无需3D场景重建即可从少量街景图像生成既逼真又符合真实场景布局的室外场景新视角。
en_tdlr: GroundControl is a satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that uses satellite imagery as additional conditioning information to generate realistic novel views from a few street-level images that faithfully adhere to real scene layout, without requiring 3D scene reconstruction.
